idea-plugin.name: WhyLine
idea-plugin.description:
WhyLine answers the question "why did this code change?" without leaving the IDE.

Select any range of code, right-click → WhyLine: Explain Why, and instantly see:

  • The linked Jira ticket and a short human-readable explanation
  • Confidence level (high / medium / low)
  • Direct link to the ticket in your browser

WhyLine reads local Git history (blame, commits, diffs) and matches it against your Jira project using a multi-signal scoring engine — no native Jira-Git integration required. Jira keys in commit messages are optional: WhyLine works via semantic matching even without them.

Optional LLM mode: provide your own OpenAI API key in settings to enable GPT-powered reranking and 2–4 sentence natural language explanations.

Setup

  1. Open Settings → Tools → WhyLine
  2. Fill in your Jira credentials (email + API token + base URL)
  3. Optionally add your Jira project keys (comma-separated) to narrow search
  4. Optionally add an OpenAI API key and enable LLM features

action.description: Explain why the selected code changed by linking it to Jira
